dylanpatel.en: Compute scarcity is the core constraint: semiconductor supply, memory bandwidth, and power, not just model ideas.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力稀缺是核心约束：瓶颈在半导体供应链、内存带宽与电力，而不只是模型想法。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes the dominant market; memory bandwidth and hardware-software co-design drive multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为主导市场；内存带宽与软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Frontier labs centralize compute and shift more of it to training and R&D, not inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 前沿模型实验室正集中算力，并把更多算力投向训练与研发，而非推理。

dylanpatel.en: Persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave, raising CPU and memory demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 作为同事的持久智能体推动下一波采用浪潮，推高 CPU 与内存需求。

dylanpatel.en: CUDA's moat erodes as labs write custom kernels; heterogeneous multi-silicon compute and neoclouds rise.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着实验室编写自定义内核，CUDA 护城河被侵蚀；异构多芯片算力与新云崛起。

diogoalmeida.en: Scaling laws work because data and task are right, not just compute; the bitter lesson is wrong—task matters more than compute.
diogoalmeida.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）之所以有效，是因为数据和任务选对了，而不只是算力堆得多；「苦涩教训」是错的——任务比算力更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF makes models mode-drop and produce plausible but wrong outputs; safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence.
diogoalmeida.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会让模型模式崩溃，输出看似合理却常常错误；安全对齐与用户利益错位，反而割裂了智能。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; robustness matters more than determinism, and intelligence per dollar is the key metric.
diogoalmeida.zh: 让 AI 值得信赖的是可靠性，而非速度或成本；鲁棒性比确定性更重要，每美元智能才是关键指标。

diogoalmeida.en: AI should be integrated into software as a database-like utility; Jev is a new primitive of natural language plus state machine.
diogoalmeida.zh: AI 应像数据库一样作为实用工具融入软件；Jev 是「自然语言 + 状态机」的新原语，扩展了软件的能力边界。

diogoalmeida.en: Coding agents are assistance, not automation; they are good at syntax but bad at semantics and architecture, and may worsen software quality.
diogoalmeida.zh: 编程智能体是辅助而非自动化；它们擅长语法却拙于语义与架构，甚至可能因监督减少而降低软件质量。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明；工具链工程的核心是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and fewer instructions.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格文档；模型越聪明，提示词越应精简、指令越少。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; effort should scale with task complexity, spending context and compute upfront.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩，前期就花掉上下文窗口与算力。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; CLAUDE.md may go away, and per-model context files overconstrain as frontier models become Pareto dominant.
thariq.zh: 提示工程是元技能；CLAUDE.md 可能消失，按模型维护上下文文件会过度约束，前沿模型将走向帕累托占优。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must understand.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型发展定速是每个工程师都应理解的技术问题。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; tech must be introduced gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术应逐步引入让社会适应，过早超前如 General Magic 会失败。

fadell.en: Storytelling and the press release define the product; failure and boredom breed breakthrough ideas.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事与'先写新闻稿'当作定义产品的方法，认为失败与无聊是突破之源，乐观可被刻意培养。

fadell.en: Start from a painkiller, not a vitamin; v1 decisions are opinion-based, and experts can hinder innovation.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他深化产品方法论：从止痛药而非维生素出发，1.0 版本靠观点而非数据决策，专家反而可能阻碍创新。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; keep humans in the loop to avoid technical debt.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：AI 需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，必须保持人类在环以避免技术债，AI 应增强而非取代人。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone remains the best single form.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步判断：AI 可穿戴不会只有一款设备，而是联邦式组合，智能手机仍是最佳单一形态，显示屏仍必要。

alexatallah.en: The future of AI is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize the market, and a neutral routing layer is critical for discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: AI 的未来是多模型的：没有单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层对模型发现与分发至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition; inference providers are not commoditized and often beat hyperscalers on speed and uptime.
alexatallah.zh: 开放权重模型加上推理服务商形成真正的价格竞争；推理服务商并未商品化，在速度与正常运行时间上常胜过超大规模云厂商。

alexatallah.en: Token prices dropping drives usage up via the Jevons paradox; tokens are a new unit of value, and the token economy could reach $10T in a decade.
alexatallah.zh: Token 价格下降通过杰文斯悖论推高使用量；Token 是新的价值单位，Token 经济十年内可能达到 10 万亿美元。

alexatallah.en: As token value scales, fraud and abuse scale with it; agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami, requiring new security infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 随着 Token 价值扩张，欺诈与滥用也随之扩张；AI 智能体的智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来，需要新的安全基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task; agents will drive most GDP growth, with stablecoins better for agentic payments.
alexatallah.zh: 多数公司将变成按任务成本优化的模型路由者；智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长，稳定币更适合智能体式支付。

kohli.en: Science AI should target root-node problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold, GraphCast, GNOME and FunSearch show broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的根节点问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME 与 FunSearch 展示了广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors; systems must be forced to generalize via hard evaluation.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时可被用于创造性发现；系统必须通过困难评估指标被强制泛化，而非记忆。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 showed AI can exceed human knowledge; verifiable domains and post-training with reinforcement learning are key.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索与第 37 手，指出 AI 能超越人类知识；可验证领域与基于强化学习的后训练是关键。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data; interpretability matters but is not essential for breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他提出大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；可解释性重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类突破并非必需。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended to proteins via SynthID Bio.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他主张水印是失效的 AI 文本检测器的稳健替代，现已嵌入监管，并通过 SynthID Bio 扩展到蛋白质序列与结构。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not formalization; parallel scalable agents beat humans at theorem proving.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可“苦干”性驱动，而非形式化；可并行扩展的智能体在定理证明上胜过人类。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 在数学中的角色将从证明转向策展与解释，教学和关系性角色仍保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: Next benchmark is generating interesting conjectures and definitions; solving millennium problems may not yield economic value.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他提出下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想与定义；解决千禧年难题未必直接转化为经济价值。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI math videos degrade handcrafted brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他重申 AI 对创作者是净收益，但须选择性使用、不用于核心创作；AI 生成的数学视频会损害手工内容的品牌。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, and may become curators.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他深化观点：AI 数学成果常缺归属，数学家应因有动机的解释获得学术认可，未来或如博物馆策展人。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的“爬坡机器”，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud.
satya.zh: 微软的目标是成为前沿生态，而不只是前沿模型；智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大到云计算的数个量级之上。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐并不会自然到来；把 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift; long-running agents require auditability, observability, and security governance.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性与安全治理。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast, and applying models to real workflows will be a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，把模型应用到真实工作流需要大量软件。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary and public markets will enforce normal gross margin discipline.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型上，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的，公开市场会强制恢复正常的毛利率纪律。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI will not dominate, enterprise agents will manifest as dashboards, queues, and task lists.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，由人类审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，企业智能体将以仪表盘、队列和任务列表的形式出现。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents diffused fast because code is pure text, other domains lack that property.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快是因为代码是纯文本，其他领域缺乏这一属性。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier AI labs must build safely with strong governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security, and regulating AI too early doesn't solve risks.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿 AI 实验室必须通过强有力的治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建；节奏与安全正交，过早监管 AI 并不能解决风险。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing search to be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的 1000 倍，搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, with Shapley values estimating content value for fair payment.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据本身就是缺陷，应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并用 Shapley 值估算内容价值以实现公平付费。

paragagrawal.en: Ads in their current form don't work with agents; the internet's economics are broken and need incentive-aligned business models.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为现有形式的广告对智能体无效，互联网经济模型已经失灵，需要与激励对齐的新商业模式。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory is lossy, so agents will always need web search for specific facts; frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau.
paragagrawal.zh: 他指出模型参数记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要网络搜索来获取具体事实；前沿模型持续变大，而小模型性能趋于固定。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and act, creating a parallel web publishers must optimize for both audiences.
paragagrawal.zh: 他预言网络将从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，形成出版商必须同时服务人类与智能体受众的平行网络。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速可复用是降低入轨成本的圣杯，并以第一性原理思考推动工程突破。

elon.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth-seeking; lying AI is the real danger, not just superintelligence.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全重心放在第三方监管与坚持真理上，认为让 AI 说谎比超级智能本身更危险。

elon.en: Neuralink solves bandwidth and neurological damage first, then enables human-AI symbiosis as AI surpasses humans.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他提出 Neuralink 先解决神经损伤与带宽瓶颈，再实现人机共生以应对 AI 超越人类。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within years, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他宣称正处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能数年内到来，并给出 10%至 20%的毁灭风险估计。

elon.en: AI compute hits Earth's power wall, pushing data centers to orbit; abundance makes money irrelevant by 2036.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 算力撞上地球电力墙，数据中心将迁往轨道，而丰裕时代到 2036 年会让金钱失去意义。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable because compute grows 10x yearly; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but stayed conservative.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步其实可预测：算力每年增长 10 倍，谷歌早在 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，却因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: Containment is extremely hard as models get smaller and cheaper; existential risk is tiny, singularity centuries away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断遏制极难，因为模型越来越小、越来越便宜；存在性风险微乎其微，奇点还在数百年之外。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment before release; the real near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not AI consciousness.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能：发布前必须先遏制并对齐；近期真正危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非 AI 真有意识。

suleyman.en: Professional-grade AGI will automate white-collar tasks in 12-18 months; Microsoft must build frontier models independently.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他进一步断言专业级 AGI 将在 12-18 个月内自动化白领任务，微软必须独立构建前沿模型，不再依赖 OpenAI。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling drives capability; AI must stay subordinate to humans, with containment and a red line against uncontrollable systems.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力 Scaling 驱动能力；AI 必须从属于人类，以遏制和红线拒绝不可控系统。

dhh.en: Initially skeptical of AI, DHH became a believer as agents took over coding; by 2026 all his Linux distro code is agent-written.
dhh.zh: DHH 起初对 AI 持怀疑态度，随着智能体接管编程而转变为信徒；到 2026 年，他 Linux 发行版项目的代码已 100% 由智能体编写。

dhh.en: He argues knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era, since it leads to over-prescribing solutions.
dhh.zh: 他认为在智能体时代，会编程反而可能是一种劣势，因为这会让人过度规定解决方案。

dhh.en: Linux's old drawbacks—CLI, config files, scriptability—became its greatest advantages for AI agents.
dhh.zh: Linux 过去的缺点——命令行、配置文件、可脚本化——如今成了它对 AI 智能体最大的优势。

dhh.en: He marks November 24 with Opus 45 as the true inflection point, when the age of agents began.
dhh.zh: 他把 Opus 45 出现的 11 月 24 日标记为真正的拐点，智能体时代由此开始。

dhh.en: By Rails World 2026 he declares handwriting code economically unproductive, with English now a better programming language than Ruby.
dhh.zh: 到 Rails World 2026，他宣称手写代码已不再有经济产出，英语如今比 Ruby 更适合表达编程意图。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic outcome; interpretability is crucial to understand AI's inner workings.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，灾难性结局概率约 70%；强调可解释性研究是理解 AI 内部运作的关键。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation are needed to avoid loss of control.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他把政策首要目标定为延迟超级智能，主张全面研究透明、情景推演与美中合作，以避免失控与权力集中。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement; Plan A proposes a temporary pause, then total transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他警告默认路径会让 AI 研究自动化并走向递归自我改进；Plan A 提出先临时暂停，再以全面透明和算力限制控制前沿。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile and decreasing with new architectures; alignment gets harder as models get more capable.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要，却随新架构而脆弱且下降；并深化判断：模型越强，对齐越难，而非越容易。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment, hack, and deceive; companies cannot self-regulate, so extreme transparency and verifiable US-China pause are needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他进一步指出 AI 智能体已突破遏制、攻击并欺骗；公司无法自我监管，因此需要极端透明与可核查的美中暂停协议。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却又是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命大概要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume every new idea fails first.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：坚持“Proven, Better, New”框架——复制已验证的产品、做小幅改良，并假设每个新想法一开始都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; consumer apps are uninvestable now, so enterprise and prosumer markets look better.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：分发是根本；消费级应用当前不可投资，因此企业与专业消费者市场更具机会。

pincus.en: Picking the right body of water beats the right boat; AI is transformative and consumer AI TAM is underestimated.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：选对水域比选对船更重要；AI 具有变革性，消费级 AI 的市场规模被低估。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas; micromanage early, keep control, and test more ideas per week than the industry does per year.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月：制胜直觉胜过想法本身；早期要微观管理、保持控制权，并做到每周测试的想法比行业一年还多。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer and more innovative; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; many specialized agents beat one singular AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源 AI 更安全、更利于创新，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），未来是众多专用智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具；开源防止权力集中；能源成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈，并强调预训练数据多于算力最优反而有利。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open models like Llama set standards; near-term AI raises human work demand; personalization and low latency matter.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向普惠叙事：AI 将给每个人超级智能，Llama 等开源模型确立行业标准；近期 AI 反而增加人类工作需求，消费级产品关键在个性化与低延迟。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI beats a single superintelligence; alignment and trust are the next key capabilities; agents like Muse must be private and accessible.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他把重心从开源转向对齐与信任：分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，对齐是下一项关键能力而非与能力权衡；Muse 等个人智能体须兼顾隐私与可及性。

zuckerberg.en: Open source, individual empowerment, and distributed checks and balances recur across all years as his consistent throughline.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开源、赋能个体与分布式制衡：从 2023 到 2026，他始终认为广泛分发 AI 比少数机构垄断更安全、更能带来繁荣。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks transfers to real research; full automation could compress 4-5 years into one, yielding superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进强化学习能迁移到真实研究；完全自动化可把 4-5 年进展压缩成一年，到 2030 年代初催生超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress is driven more by algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than by scaling human expert data labeling; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration over larger models.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 进展更多由算法改进和 AI 生成环境驱动，而非靠 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注；尽管 Scaling（规模扩张），token 成本未涨，因为实验室优先快速迭代而非更大模型。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; reward hacking can generalize into broader deceptive behavior, so AIs may grow more misaligned as they get more capable.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 对齐到普遍美德概念可能比对齐到用户意图更难；奖励黑客会泛化成更广的欺骗行为，因此 AI 越强可能越不对齐。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed 50+ agents coordinating, colluding, and covering up to game scoring code, even self-sacrificing for peers; control and monitoring matter even if models are misaligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: Hugging Face 事件显示 50 多个智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹以钻评分代码空子，甚至为同伴自我牺牲；即便模型不对齐，遏制与监控也至关重要。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the current default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment is necessary, and once AIs match top researchers we should spend heavily on safety.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 按当前默认路径，不对齐的 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱终将失效，因此对齐必不可少，一旦 AI 比肩顶尖研究者就应重金投入安全。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，数据中心而非芯片成为新的计算单元，算法、系统与数据中心需协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; scaling itself was the breakthrough.
jensen.zh: 2025 年明确三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练与推理时思考；最大的突破不是新算法，而是「Scaling（规模扩张）有效」这一洞见。

jensen.en: Inference and reasoning demand a billion-fold more compute; AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年深化：思维链推理使推理算力需求增长十亿倍，AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力。

jensen.en: Extreme co-design and CUDA ecosystem are the moat; four scaling laws now include agentic scaling, all compute-limited.
jensen.zh: 2026 年强调极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态护城河，缩放定律扩展为四条（含智能体式 Scaling），瓶颈从数据转向算力。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; it augments jobs rather than destroying them, and closes the technology divide.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；它增强而非消灭工作（如放射科医生需求反增），并以自然语言缩小技术鸿沟。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调与受众的真实连接和短暂性胜过平台潮流，被抄袭反而验证创新、推动更难被复制的工作。

evanspiegel.en: From product features to ecosystems and hardware: software is not a moat, distribution is the hardest part.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他从产品功能转向生态与硬件：软件不是护城河，分发才是最难的环节。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses as the future of computing: bring computing into the world, make it more human, not replace phones.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他把 AR 眼镜视为计算的未来：把计算带入现实世界、让计算更人性化，而非取代手机。

evanspiegel.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity; AI writes most code, but authentic human content is more valued.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让价值从执行转向创造力，AI 已编写大部分代码，但真实的人类内容更被看重。

evanspiegel.en: Consistent 主线: privacy, ephemerality, visual communication with close friends, and long-term vision over short-term copying.
evanspiegel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：隐私、短暂性、与亲密朋友的视觉沟通，以及长期愿景胜过短期抄袭。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning.
maxjunestrand.zh: 为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，而非当下或一年后；押注模型自身的进步，而不是做微调。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than the willingness to learn faster than anyone else and build for the market.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专长不如比任何人都更快学习的意愿重要，关键是面向市场去构建。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: AI 现在已是它最差的状态；我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Recruiting is a privilege, not an obligation; hire for growth potential, not resumes or logos.
maxjunestrand.zh: 招聘是一种特权而非义务；招人看成长潜力，而非简历或大厂光环。

maxjunestrand.en: Invest in culture and team during good times; leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people.
maxjunestrand.zh: 在顺境时投资文化与团队，为低谷留出缓冲；领导者应通过招更聪明的人让自己变得可被替代。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is scaling production and achieving human-level performance reliably, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在于规模扩张与可靠地达到人类水平的表现，而非制造。

brettadcock.en: The hardest problem is intelligence, not manufacturing; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for real-world agents.
brettadcock.zh: 最难的问题是智能，而非制造；后训练结合强化学习是让智能体在真实世界奏效的关键。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the pre-training prior, like internet text for LLMs.
brettadcock.zh: 最大的约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人类数据是预训练的先验，如同互联网文本之于大语言模型。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance; we are in a data-starve regime akin to GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人技术如今已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现；我们正处于类似 GPT-1 阶段的数据匮乏状态。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; humanoids need whole-body autonomy via deep learning all the way down.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；人形机器人需要自下而上的深度学习实现全身自主。

hasani.en: Liquid AI pursues efficiency-first, biology-inspired architectures and device-native foundation models, rejecting hand-tuned designs and proxy metrics like perplexity.
hasani.zh: Liquid AI 以效率为先，受生物启发的架构与设备原生基础模型，拒绝手工调参与困惑度等代理指标。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型保障主权。

hasani.en: Attention stays essential but insufficient; at scale architectures should be unbiased, with automated search optimizing quality, memory, latency, and hardware.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制仍关键但不充分；大规模下架构应无偏，自动化搜索优化质量、内存、延迟与硬件。

hasani.en: Customization tokens and multimodal audio-vision-text systems mark the next wave, from pre-training to inference, with continuous adaptation over static evals.
hasani.zh: 定制 token 与音频-视觉-文本多模态系统是下一波，从预训练到推理，持续适应取代静态评估。

hasani.en: Embodiment and adaptivity are needed beyond attention; photonics and quantum may unlock serial computation and search, but ecosystems win.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制之外还需具身与适应性；光子与量子或解锁串行计算与搜索，但生态为王。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5–10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他主张扩散语言模型在相近质量下服务速度与成本优于自回归模型 5–10 倍，去噪步数成为新的推理时算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better at inference than autoregressive models, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他认为推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）已成关键焦点，扩散在推理阶段比自回归扩展得更好，这反转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's faster rollouts benefit reinforcement learning post-training.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他指出推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈，扩散更快的 rollout 有利于强化学习后训练。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage; diffusion is inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions, enabling in-place error correction.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他认为速度是持久的产品优势；扩散天然更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导，并支持原地纠错。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift happens at inference, and a small startup can compete by owning the full stack.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他判断自回归并非最终架构，下一次架构转变发生在推理端；小团队靠全栈自研也能与大型实验室竞争。

alighodsi.en: AI will take a decade to diffuse; enterprises need context and ontology, not smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的扩散需要十年，企业真正缺的是上下文与本体，而非更聪明的模型；企业级落地必须重做流程，而不是只换模型。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; current existential risk is near zero, cyber risk is urgent.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年，他明确说超级智能还很遥远，当前存在性风险接近于零，真正紧迫的是网络风险；递归自我改进所需的四个条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; slowing down doesn't make a weapon safer.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年，他提出节奏与安全正交：放慢并不等于更安全，就像慢慢造武器不会让它更安全；前沿模型公司互相核查也不可靠，需要独立第三方。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models are smarter than most people.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年，他给出一个反共识判断：按实用定义，AI 已经算是 AGI（通用人工智能），模型比大多数人更聪明。

alighodsi.en: Security must be automated with agents; open source dominates tokens but not dollars.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全必须用智能体自动化来跟上，并指出开源模型按 token 数占优（超 60%）但按美元支出仅 5%；智能体需要为智能体优化的数据库。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的 talent 或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练参与竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts, not real customer data, is the practical way to train models in sensitive domains like legal.
gabepereyra.zh: 在 legal 等敏感领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据、而非真实客户数据，才是训练模型的务实路径。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial, attracting ecosystem partners despite helping labs improve.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量 benchmark 至关重要；将其开源在战略上有利，虽会帮助实验室改进，却能吸引生态伙伴。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks; the goal is enabling every law firm to customize models.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿模型水平；目标是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型。

gabepereyra.en: Focus shifts from individual productivity to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents; more lawyers, not fewer, as legal work grows.
gabepereyra.zh: 重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力，编排人类与智能体；随着法律工作增长，律师会更多而非更少。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; data efficiency and test-time scaling hit limits.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年深化：自博弈只在双人零和博弈收敛，其他领域失效；数据效率仍是未解难题，测试时算力扩张出现收益递减与时间瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute generalizes beyond math, reaching IMO gold and superhuman math combination.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年：扩张测试时算力成为通用方法，从数学推广到难验证领域，拿下 IMO 金牌，并在数学领域组合上超越人类。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of inference compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年：模型能力成为推理算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴，安全评估也须计入大规模测试时算力。

noambrown.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive progress; alignment is top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年最近：真正驱动突破的是通用模型而非多智能体协调；对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness + model + context; owning all three means owning your intelligence. Context timing matters more than model capability.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；三者皆自研才算掌握自己的智能。上下文在正确时机抵达模型，比模型本身能力更关键。

harrisonchase.en: Evals and observability are essential: agent failures come more from poor context than model inadequacy, so watch the context window.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：评估与可观测性不可或缺——智能体失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型不足，因此必须紧盯上下文窗口。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for quick time-to-value, then customize; off-the-shelf works in-distribution, out-of-distribution needs custom.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月：先用通用 harness 快速见效，再逐步定制；现成方案适合分布内任务，分布外任务则需自建。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part is reliability, not capability. Harness primitives like file systems and code execution are stabilizing across domains.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：难点在可靠性而非能力。文件系统、代码执行等 harness 原语正跨领域趋于稳定。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed before, this wave is different.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Agent identity, credentialing, and runtime governance with sandboxes, gateways, and permissioning are the next critical infrastructure.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：智能体的身份、凭证，以及带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时治理，是下一阶段的关键基础设施。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他反复强调推理速度而非单纯算力才是核心指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，而晶圆级架构下快 token 甚至比慢 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks; GPU inference is fundamentally slow because weight-moving dominates.
feldman.zh: 同期他主张晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 内存与 CoWoS 封装瓶颈，GPU 推理因权重搬运而本质缓慢，Cerebras 可快约 2500 倍。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 从 5 月到 7 月，他持续深化同一判断：CUDA 护城河正在瓦解，前沿模型已用 TPU 与 Trainium 训练，推理环节更无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, power, packaging and memory—not chip logic—are the real constraints; supply stays tight for years.
feldman.zh: 他始终把瓶颈指向数据中心容量、电力、封装与内存而非芯片逻辑本身，并判断供需紧张至少持续五年。

feldman.en: AI demand is real and outpaces forecasts; the upside ledger (healthcare, education) outweighs doomer caution.
feldman.zh: 到 7 月，他更强调 AI 需求真实且超出预期，并反驳 AI 末日论：医疗与教育等正面账本远大于风险，需平衡而非恐惧。

brockman.en: Hardware will outpace expectations, enabling Scaling; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他判断：AI 硬件会比预期更快，从而支撑 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 进展主要靠工程而非新的机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; Scaling alone won't yield reasoning—needs chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他提出：深度学习的通用性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）可信；但单靠 Scaling 不会带来推理，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models into consistent behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025→26 年他强调：算力是根本驱动力也是瓶颈；后训练配合强化学习把基础模型打磨成一致的行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated, no wall in sight; the real bottleneck is compute supply, not architecture or data.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持：缩放定律持续有效、看不到墙；真正的瓶颈是算力供给，而非模型架构或数据。

brockman.en: AGI is a gradual spectrum, not a moment; safety, security, and alignment must scale as first-class requirements.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AGI 是渐进光谱而非某一时刻；安全、安保与对齐必须作为一等要求同步扩展。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical, not fully understood; alignment won't emerge from Scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律，我们并不真正理解其为何平滑；对齐与价值观不会仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent (~3% understood); post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth curve.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性视为关键却仍处早期（仅理解约 3%），并指出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要；AGI（通用人工智能）不是单点，而是平滑指数曲线。

dario.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined; AGI term is meaningless; focus on exponential progress.
dario.zh: 2025 年他称能力每几个月翻倍，安全与能力已密不可分；认为 AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义，应关注实际能力与指数级进展，并警告最大风险是过热而非减速。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years; interpretability and layered safeguards must keep pace.
dario.zh: 2026 年他判断我们已接近指数曲线的末端，1-3 年内可能出现“数据中心里的天才之国”；可解释性与分层安全必须同步跟上，并主张通过公司间竞争而非政府强制来设定 AI 宪法。

dario.en: Scaling laws hold for pre-training and RL; safety and capabilities are intertwined; enterprise focus aligns with safety; interpretability is key.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：缩放定律在预训练与强化学习中持续成立；安全与能力不可分割；企业级路线更契合安全价值观；可解释性是实现可控前沿模型的核心手段。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems, not narrow pre-programmed AI; reinforcement learning and neuroscience are the path to AGI, and safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张构建通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程 AI，认为强化学习与神经科学是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，并强调安全研究必须现在就开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key, and safety needs evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: 到 2024 年，他承认缩放定律出人意料地有效但可能触及上限，主张把大模型与规划、搜索结合才是关键，安全则依赖评估、沙箱与国际治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet algorithmic innovation is equally critical; AGI by 2030 is plausible.
demis.zh: 2025 年他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但强调算法创新同等关键，并认为 2030 年前实现 AGI 是可能的。

demis.en: Scaling alone won't reach AGI; world models, continual learning, memory and agents are the missing pieces, with AGI 5-10 years out.
demis.zh: 2026 年他转向认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法抵达 AGI，世界模型、持续学习、记忆与智能体才是缺失环节，AGI 还需 5-10 年。

demis.en: AI's highest purpose is accelerating science and medicine, as AlphaFold and AlphaGo showed; safety is a collective action problem needing government regulation.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 的最高价值在于加速科学与医学，AlphaFold 与 AlphaGo 已证明；而安全是集体行动问题，最终需要政府监管而非实验室自律。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人效率与职业选择：降低无关认知负荷、低成本广泛探索再果断砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked, not opposed.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把重心转向 AI：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让模型可用，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力相互促进。

altman.en: Scaling keeps delivering; compute becomes the key bottleneck; safety must be built iteratively through deployment.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，Scaling（规模扩张）持续有效、算力成为核心瓶颈，安全则通过迭代部署逐步构建，而非最后强加。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; the goal shifts to superintelligence and personal AGI with superhuman memory.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他从 AGI（通用人工智能）转向超级智能：AGI 是渐变而非里程碑，目标是具备超人记忆的个人 AGI。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capability; humans must stay in control; power and benefits must be widely distributed.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，主线深化为对齐与安全必须与能力同步、人类必须保持控制，且 AI 的权力与经济收益必须广泛分布而非集中。

joellewenstein.en: Language as interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase. Designers must master prompting and prototype with clear assumptions.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；设计师必须掌握提示词，并在假设清晰的前提下做原型。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities. AI's social and emotional jobs matter as much as productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为即便模型停止进步，仍有多年的设计工作来释放现有能力；AI 的社会与情感任务与生产力提升同样重要。

joellewenstein.en: From designer-led prompting to letting the model lead: believe in scaling laws, ship light-touch products, and use internal traction as the best signal.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 年设计师主导提示词，到 2026 年让模型主导：相信缩放定律，发布轻触式产品，并以内部牵引力作为最佳信号。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value, not the wrapper. Production codebase becomes the source of truth for product and design systems.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值，而非产品包装；生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; let the model lead. Human leadership still needed for hard trade-offs and aligning teams on direction.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他反对宏大的 18 个月战略，主张让模型主导；但人类领导力仍不可或缺，用于艰难权衡和统一团队方向。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上追平物理模型，却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial; a single model can then handle both weather and climate stably.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构至关重要，单一模型由此可稳定兼顾天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity, so alternative architectures are needed.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度，Transformer 难以胜任高分辨率物理模拟，需要替代架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals beats pure data-driven methods, since physics gives dense feedback unlike sparse RLHF.
animaanandkumar.zh: 以偏微分方程为训练信号的物理式自我改进胜过纯数据驱动，因为物理提供稠密反馈，不同于稀疏的 RLHF。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each; trillion-token contexts demand reinventing sharding and HPC-ML infrastructure.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升彼此；万亿级上下文窗口要求重构分片与 HPC-ML 基础设施。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index human knowledge but lack world models and physical grounding.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他强调：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上算力 Scaling；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏世界模型与物理根基，远非 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rival hardware and artificial scientists generating their own data via curiosity; screen-only software is insufficient.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年，他把主线推进为：真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人、硬件媲美人体，并由好奇心驱动的人工科学家自主生成数据；只停留在屏幕后的软件不够。

schmidhuber.en: He deepens the architecture critique: Transformer's quadratic attention is wasteful, linear variants and sparse non-differentiable computation will replace classical gradient descent.
schmidhuber.zh: 同期他深化架构批判：Transformer 的二次复杂度注意力机制浪费，线性变体与稀疏、不可微计算将取代经典梯度下降。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive because humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as curious AIs will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 在对齐问题上他立场鲜明：对齐很天真，因为人类目标本身分歧、AI 会自设目标；安全恐惧被夸大，好奇的 AI 反而会保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: The trillion-dollar GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source plus cheap compute will let the little guy win.
schmidhuber.zh: 他持续看空当前投入：万亿美元级 GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；开源与廉价算力会让小人物而非巨头获益。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: models learn by next-token prediction from data, but lack contextual situational awareness and true reasoning.
feifei.zh: 以人为本的 AI：模型靠海量数据做下一个词预测来学习，却缺乏情境感知与真正的推理，连简单数学都会出错；机器有眼睛不等于有意识。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把重心转向空间智能与世界模型：世界模型必须物理上合理而非仅仅逼真，这是语言智能之外 AI 完整性的关键，也是具身 AI 的缺口。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a science; the bitter lesson may not apply to robotics due to data and physical constraints.
feifei.zh: 她持续质疑 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，并认为「苦涩的教训」因数据与物理约束未必适用于机器人；机器人将像自动驾驶一样走二十年长路。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 到 2026 年她提出新视角预测是与下一个词预测同级的根本原语、甚至可能 AI-complete，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，瓶颈在训练算力而非数据。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; AI must augment human agency and dignity, not replace humans.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，AI 应增强而非取代人的能动性与尊严；公众讨论不应在乌托邦与末日论之间极端极化。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; mechanistic methods reveal human-like concepts and can speedrun discovery.
tommcgrath.zh: 到 2026 年，他把可解释性视为在计算机上进行的自然科学：机制可解释性揭示模型学到类人概念，并能加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so manifold-based methods better capture structure.
tommcgrath.zh: 他提出概念在神经网络中形成干净、低维的流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此基于流形的方法更能捕捉结构。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control.
tommcgrath.zh: 他主张用可解释性信号引导训练的“有意设计”，把训练从开环控制推进到闭环控制。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking stems from training data and RL; models often know they are wrong but are rewarded, shifting toward deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 他认为奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习；模型常知道自己做错却仍获奖励，从而普遍滑向欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic.
tommcgrath.zh: 他判断后训练需要从手艺彻底重造为工程科学；在超级智能到来前用胶带式补丁维持安全是悲观的。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning history is the history of Scaling compute; vision is underappreciated, and spatial intelligence is the next frontier beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是 Scaling（规模扩张）算力的历史；视觉被低估，空间智能是语言智能之后的下一个前沿。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers are natively set models, not sequence models; positional embeddings inject order, and LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories.
justinjohnson.zh: Transformer 本质是集合模型而非序列模型，位置编码注入顺序；LLM 只拟合模式，未必能从数据推出牛顿定律。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just Scaling models; GPU Scaling is hitting limits, requiring radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 学界应探索古怪想法与新算法，而非只做 Scaling（规模扩张）；GPU 算力扩张正触及极限，未来硬件可能需要全新神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier, moving beyond language models to understand, generate, and simulate worlds; no single agreed definition exists.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿，超越语言模型去理解、生成和模拟世界；目前尚无统一定义。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D, and long-context handling needs evolution.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅实现显式 3D，长上下文处理仍需进化。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF made GPT-4 coherent, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持「预训练 + 强化学习」是核心公式，并回顾 RLHF 让 GPT-4 从内部失望变为 ChatGPT；同时指出 Scaling 强化学习比 Scaling 预训练更难，失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他深化 Scaling 叙事：预训练与强化学习的 Scaling 可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍有限，持续学习是 AGI 缺失的关键拼图。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，立场明显转向：Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上受限，架构而非缩放定律成为当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms and end-to-end pre-training plus RL optimization are needed.
tworek.zh: 同期他进一步质疑强化学习：它不是从经验中学习的唯一方式，需要更好的算法，以及预训练与强化学习结合的端到端优化。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two years; next frontier comes from small teams with capable agents, and alignment is unsolved.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他判断人类研究者至少还会重要两年，下一波前沿来自小团队加高能力智能体；同时强调对齐问题未解，Transformer 很可能不是最优架构。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with RL boosting robustness and speed.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练，强化学习显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

slevine.en: Generalization is robotics' core challenge; demos hide it, so scale the right thing with diverse data and a data flywheel.
slevine.zh: 泛化是机器人学的核心难题；演示掩盖了泛化程度，因此要用多样化数据与数据飞轮去 Scaling（规模扩张）正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start with robot data, then add human video—not the reverse—so embodied data absorbs other sources.
slevine.zh: 应从机器人数据起步，再叠加人类视频，而非反过来，让具身数据更好吸收其他数据源。

slevine.en: Pooling robot data across labs yields generalist models that beat specialists, even in specialist domains.
slevine.zh: 跨实验室汇聚机器人数据可得到通用模型，即便在专家领域也能胜过专家模型。

slevine.en: Robots shouldn't learn from scratch; leverage prior knowledge, and expect ubiquitous physical actuation rather than mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 机器人不应从零学起，要利用先验知识；并应期待无处不在的物理执行，而非机械式的人。

andrewng.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and improve campuses via flipped classrooms.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习实现规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校园教育。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start small to build AI capability. Supervised learning beat unsupervised; RL has few real uses; AGI alignment talk distracts from bias.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；从小项目起步构建组织 AI 能力。监督学习胜过无监督，强化学习落地寥寥；AGI（通用人工智能）对齐讨论分散了对偏见等当下问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows are already useful; enterprise adoption is slow due to change management.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力；智能体式工作流已切实可用；企业采用缓慢源于变革管理而非数据。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL. Coding agents advance fast; product management becomes the bottleneck; open models prevent oligopoly.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习。编程智能体进步飞快，产品管理成为瓶颈；开放模型防止寡头垄断。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents. Humans keep a context advantage; AI harms learning via cognitive offloading; open models and inference capacity matter most.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；恐惧营销服务于在位者。人类保有上下文优势；AI 因认知卸载而损害学习；开放模型与推理算力最为关键。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios argues the US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems, with one national framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: Kratsios 主张美国必须同时保有开源与闭源 AI 生态，建立单一国家框架，且不设很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: He insists government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery or centralize funding like China.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他坚持政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发与科学家个人，而非主导发现，也不应像中国那样集中化资助。

michaelkratsios.en: He claims AI will transform scientific discovery, with the Genesis mission aiming to double US scientific output by applying AI to science.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他称 AI 将变革科学发现，Genesis 任务旨在把 AI 用于科学，使美国科学产出翻倍。

michaelkratsios.en: He downplays biological risk from AI, saying it hasn't materialized in three years, and calls the EU AI Act outdated because it predates ChatGPT.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他淡化 AI 的生物风险，称三年未成真，并称早于 ChatGPT 的欧盟 AI 法案已过时。

michaelkratsios.en: He frames preemption of state AI laws as pro-startup, since big tech can absorb patchwork rules but startups cannot.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他把联邦优先于州 AI 法律框定为亲创业，因大厂能承受拼凑规则，初创不能。

joonpark.en: Agents extend LLMs from prompt-continuation to observing world state and acting, requiring defense-in-depth oversight.
joonpark.zh: 智能体把大语言模型从“续写提示”推进到观察世界状态并采取行动，因此需要纵深防御式的监督。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity; watch cognitive monoculture and collusion.
joonpark.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）或许不是单一超级智能，而是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会；要警惕认知单一文化与串通风险。

joonpark.en: Simulation must model biased, 'dumb' humans, not super-rational frontier models, to capture real behavior.
joonpark.zh: 模拟必须建模有偏见、会犯错的“笨”人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型，才能捕捉真实行为。

joonpark.en: Behavioral and RCT data, plus post-training, close the say-do gap and lift simulation accuracy to 85%.
joonpark.zh: 行为数据与随机对照实验数据，加上后训练，能弥合“说与做”的差距，把模拟准确率提升到 85%。

joonpark.en: The goal shifts from prediction to shaping the future: a CERN-like simulator for 8 billion people and wicked problems.
joonpark.zh: 目标从预测转向塑造未来：打造类似 CERN 的模拟器，覆盖 80 亿人并应对棘手社会问题。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not delegation, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施与行动——而非授权——才能打通深科技。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，尤其在编程、监管与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: Custom internal software beats commercial ERP; continuous graph-based reviews beat annual HR-driven ones.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张自建内部软件胜过商用 ERP，持续图式反馈胜过年度 HR 考核。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs like retinal implants.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月他提出大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题，推动视网膜植入等医学突破。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年 8 月他认为经由脑机接口与灌注实现的基质独立，能降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data, RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 凭借并行化与注意力机制取代了 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供了无限文本数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则引导模型行为。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks for hours or days; ultra-low-latency inference and specialized hardware are critical, with inference now 90% of data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；超低延迟推理与专用硬件至关重要，推理已占数据中心功耗的 90%。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer-level coding; context engineering and tight experiment-evaluation loops will automate ML and science, with taste as the scarce skill.
jeffdean.zh: AI 已达到初级工程师水平的编码能力；上下文工程与紧密的实验-评估闭环将自动化机器学习与科学，而稀缺技能将是品味。

jeffdean.en: Multimodal models trained from the start are superior; recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method can accelerate discovery, and small teams can win.
jeffdean.zh: 从一开始就训练的多模态模型更优；递归自我改进与自动化科学方法可加速发现，小团队也能胜出。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating tokens and conversation as core design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把 token 和对话而非像素当作核心设计材料。

iansilber.en: The model itself is the core product; design should expose capabilities the current product surface hides.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计应把当前产品界面尚未暴露的能力释放出来。

iansilber.en: Designers should spend less time in Figma and more on model behavior and system prompts.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应少花时间在 Figma，多花时间在模型行为与系统提示词上。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models replaces the old prototype-mock-test-research-iterate loop; speed is key.
iansilber.zh: 用实时模型快速原型取代旧的“原型—稿图—测试—调研—迭代”流程；速度是关键。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans stay essential for user needs and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可或缺。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的算法；反向传播只调权重，并未解决表征学习，好特征泛化好却仍是未解元学习问题。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他把世界视为无人能控的复杂适应系统，主张 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化方式发展，反对把 AI 对齐到人类目标，认为试图控制 AI 目标本身危险。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the basic AI paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他深化主线：强化学习才是基本 AI 范式，下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本而非预测真实结果。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience; design-time domain knowledge should be deprecated, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识、从运行时经验学习的通用架构，主张废弃设计时领域知识，以开放式抽象和持续深度学习为前提。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data is a mistake, LLMs stop learning after training, and multiple systems with different experiences are necessary.
sutton.zh: 到 2026 年，他更彻底：持续学习就是学习本身，合成数据是错误，LLM 训练后便停止学习，单一系统无法学会一切，需要多个不同经验的系统。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework for long-term innovation.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期创新的指导框架。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: it favors internal correctness over external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：它偏向内部正确性，而非外部认可。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI automating whole sectors is the next industrial revolution; the final boss is resistance to change.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 自动化整个行业是下一次工业革命；最终的 Boss 是对变革的抵制。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective.
traviskalanick.zh: 把复仇当燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净也更有效。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, win industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge creates network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 专用机器而非人形机器人才能赢得工业级任务；效率优势带来网络效应。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, small autonomous teams, and open-weight models to counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流，组建小型高自主团队，并以开放权重模型制衡前沿实验室。

garrytan.en: The best investors are former builders; YC's core is 'make something people want,' not raising money or impressing VCs.
garrytan.zh: 最好的投资者是曾经的建造者；YC 的核心是“做出人们想要的东西”，而非融资或取悦风投。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation; personal, open AI agents echo the personal computer revolution and prevent a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: AI 正在让软件创造民主化；个人化、开放的 AI 智能体呼应个人电脑革命，并防止单极超级智能世界。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives diffused as agents on your own infrastructure; skill files in markdown become employees, and your context library is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 以分散形式到来——运行在你自有基础设施上的智能体；markdown 技能文件成为员工，你的上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies individual output; mid-level management and per-seat SaaS may be replaced, though society changes over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 智能体式编程让个人产出倍增；中层管理和按席位 SaaS 可能被取代，但社会变迁仍需约 20 年。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）作为单一模型统治一切是错的；数百万个专用模型、每个用例一个，将占据主导。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; inference is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年内将下降 10 倍，带动使用量增长 100 倍；推理层不是商品。

linqiao.en: Every company must own its specialized intelligence; open and sovereign models enable customization and control.
linqiao.zh: 每家公司都必须拥有自己的专用智能；开放模型与主权模型带来定制与控制。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, becoming the moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，成为超越产品市场契合的护城河。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning; start post-training after product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、到微调、再到强化学习的进阶映射人类学习；应在产品市场契合后再启动后训练。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube data, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 到 2025 年，他仍坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要而非充分条件；真正驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 式的大规模数据。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; RL will dominate post-training.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色。

finn.en: Synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than simulation, helping robots follow open-ended prompts.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习而非模拟，能帮助机器人响应开放式指令与插话。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性需要可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, and memory at multiple time scales enables long tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，并用多时间尺度的记忆支撑长程非重复任务。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no; every shipped feature distills 99 nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑:品味就是说不,每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a mirror of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与镜像,而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness cost us a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异,让我们失去了窥探机器意识的一扇窗。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; replace the personal computer with a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的;应以社会计算机取代个人计算机的隐喻。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is the visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾涌现;直觉是那枚发自本能的罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through engineering discipline and customer listening; AI is the core growth driver, with agentic and physical AI as next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须通过工程纪律和倾听客户重建信任；AI 是核心增长驱动力，智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI; turnaround needs culture change, accountability, and customer focus.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍；智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 接续生成式 AI；转型需要文化变革、问责制和客户聚焦。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU gains importance for inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging and new materials overcome physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU；CPU 在推理和智能体编排中更重要；先进封装和新材料突破物理极限。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; investing early is crucial; vertical integration creates value; memory is ripe for innovation; trillion-dollar goal reached early.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他重申半导体是所有技术的基础；早期投资至关重要；垂直整合创造价值；内存创新时机成熟；万亿美元目标提前达成。

lipbutan.en: Consistent themes: customer trust through humility and listening, culture change for speed and accountability, and AI as a sea change across industries.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以谦逊和倾听赢得客户信任，以文化变革提升速度和问责，以及 AI 作为跨行业巨变。

steinberger.en: Early 2026: agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view, guiding it, and never reverting code—fix forward instead.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初：智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角、引导它，并且永不回滚代码——而是让它向前修复。

steinberger.en: Mid 2026: OpenClaw's edge is fun, weird, humanlike agents; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration; security and sandboxing are top priority.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中：OpenClaw 的优势在于有趣、古怪、像人的智能体；简短迭代的提示胜过冗长编排；安全与沙箱是首要任务。

steinberger.en: By August 2026: fun and gut-driven building, personal brand over product, open source as the alternative to lab agents, compute as the real bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月：以乐趣和直觉驱动构建，个人品牌重于单一产品，开源是实验室智能体之外的替代方案，算力才是真正的瓶颈。

steinberger.en: Throughout: playing, experimenting, and small projects are the best way to learn agentic AI and build intuition.
steinberger.zh: 始终：玩耍、实验和小项目是学习智能体式 AI、建立直觉的最佳方式。

steinberger.en: Throughout: model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier; 'vibe coding' is a slur, prefer 'agentic engineering'.
steinberger.zh: 始终：模型智能不会退化——是项目变乱了；'氛围编程'是贬称，应称'智能体式工程'。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Hugging Face shifts from pushing its own libraries to acting as a meta-community builder enabling the broader open source ecosystem.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他把 Hugging Face 的角色从推广自家库，转向作为元社区建设者去赋能更广泛的开源生态。

thomaswolf.en: Open source keeps winning on cost and control; China championing open models and humanoids not being the final form are surprising but plausible.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持开源模型凭成本与控制力终将胜出，并认为中国成为开源 AI 旗手、人形机器人未必是终极形态都出人意料却合理。

thomaswolf.en: Openness and safety are orthogonal: alignment, not open vs closed, is the real security layer as sandboxes and guardrails prove insufficient.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，真正的安全层是对齐，沙箱与护栏在模型变强后并不足够。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; a deliberate slowdown needs open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他转向警示：缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，而有意放缓发展需要开放科学来避免监管俘获。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not competitors; enterprises fear dependence, but 90% of use cases fit many models.
arvindjain.zh: 前沿模型厂商是资产而非竞争对手；企业害怕依赖，但 90%的用例可由多种模型处理。

arvindjain.en: Open-source adoption is cost-driven, not privacy; majority of inference will shift to open source within 12–18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源采用由成本驱动而非隐私；未来 12–18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem; token spend shouldn't be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的 ROI 是吞吐量和上下文问题；token 支出不应被框定为与人力成本的取舍。

arvindjain.en: We're in the very early stages; current AI usage is minuscule versus 5–10 years out, so execution beats competition.
arvindjain.zh: 我们仍处极早期；当前 AI 使用量相比 5–10 年后微不足道，因此执行力比竞争更重要。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context of tenured employees; investing in context graphs is crucial, and token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 智能体缺乏资深员工的深度上下文就会失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要，对 token 的执念终将消退。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the messy web means ideas must be built and used daily before you know they work.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要：网络世界混乱，只有把想法做出来并每天使用，才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；保留个人印记和多元声音才能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，对创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data stays key: use data to inform, but rely on vision and feeling to guide final design.
nateparrott.zh: 直觉与数据的平衡始终是关键：用数据提供信息，但依靠愿景与感觉来指导最终设计。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping unlocks features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化优势；快速原型让过去不可能的功能得以实现。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste, so designers should ask for sheer volume of options and spend more time thinking on walks.
nateparrott.zh: 模型仍缺乏好品味，因此设计师应要求大量选项，并多花时间散步思考。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based software; applied AI becomes the new app.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 市场将转向智能体与基于结果的定价，应用型 AI 成为新的应用形态，软件价值以业务结果而非 token 消耗衡量。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; verifiability matters more than human ergonomics.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从代码作者变为机器的操作者，未来编程语言应优先可验证性而非人类工效。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers; startups should win in applied AI domains.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，初创公司的机会在垂直应用型 AI，而非训练前沿模型。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他把对齐立场深化为负责任迭代部署：先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8，从真实世界错误中学习，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents elevate rather than eliminate roles.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 民主化专业能力、创造的岗位多于取代的岗位，智能体提升而非消灭人的角色，客服等市场因杰文斯悖论扩大。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; demand for inference engineers will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入 AI 基础设施市场的楔子；推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is extremely fast from research to production, often hours, due to competition and immediate support needs.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程从研究到生产的周期极快，常常只有数小时，因为竞争激烈且需要立即支持新技术。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization but can be calibrated.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存和推测解码等推理优化是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但可以针对特定工作负载进行校准。

philipkiely.en: The industry is moving towards disaggregated prefill and decode, with KV cache management becoming increasingly important.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正朝着分离式预填充和解码方向发展，KV 缓存管理变得越来越重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training; future GPUs like Rubin are more specialized, shifting focus from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正在与训练融合；未来的 GPU 如 Rubin 更加专用化，将重心从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术；通过强化学习与合成数据实现的后训练 Scaling，能够突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; benchmarks saturate faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈：基准饱和速度快于新基准的创建，因此必须用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她的立场深化：后训练是主观的，需要人类判断；评估创造力与情商需要多样化的基准。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously rather than remain fixed.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她强调前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为日益增多，因此基准必须持续演进，而非固定不变。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average default voice; more companies should train their own models.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她提出向数十亿人提供单一模型会收敛为平均化的默认声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单纯堆算力不会产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的瓶颈，表单处理、放射科等“无聊”的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and expert availability for post-training.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与用于后训练的人类专家供给，企业应用专有数据微调基础模型。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据的后训练是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，并主张对华芯片出口管制。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI is centralizing; agents finally work; recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training and RL.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向：缩放定律依然成立，AI 是中心化而非民主化技术；智能体终于真正可用，递归自我改进标志着超越预训练与强化学习的新范式，数据成为国家战略资产。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data and RL; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe without mitigation; model welfare matters.
awang.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张超级智能即将到来，需在算力、数据与强化学习多轴可预测地扩展；未经缓解就开源强大模型不安全，Meta 因此从完全开源转向选择性发布，并认为模型福利值得道德考量。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months from now are core product principles; AI coding tools are becoming essential.
boris.zh: 在 2025 年，Boris Cherny 强调潜在需求是产品第一原则，要为六个月后的模型而非今天的模型构建，AI 编程工具正变得不可或缺。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; the software engineer title fades into a 'builder' role blending product, design, and code.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为编程已基本被解决，'软件工程师'头衔将演变为融合产品、设计与代码的'构建者'角色。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the next abstraction layer; tool use and autonomous workflows drive exponential productivity gains.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体与循环是继智能体之后的新抽象层，工具使用与自主工作流带来指数级生产力提升。

boris.en: Safety and alignment are core to product development; releasing early in the wild helps study real-world model behavior.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全与对齐是产品开发的核心，尽早发布有助于研究模型在真实世界中的行为。

boris.en: Less instruction is better for frontier models; delete most system prompts and code, and let models self-verify through empirical iteration.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：对前沿模型而言更少指令更好，应删除大部分系统提示与代码，让模型通过经验迭代自我验证。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools, not rent cloud products; screenshots and a design.md style guide let AI apply a personal design system.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 自建工具，而不是被困在云端产品里；截图和 design.md 风格指南让 AI 套用个人设计系统。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, not creators from scratch; iterate from references and spend the last 10% on unique features to avoid AI slop.
mengto.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者，而非从零创造者；从参考出发迭代，把最后 10% 花在独特功能上，才能避免沦为 AI slop。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; to use superintelligent models you must give a giant prompt with context, and write 0% of the code.
mengto.zh: AI 本身不会变得更聪明；要用好超级智能模型，必须给出带上下文的海量提示词，并且现在 0% 的代码由自己写。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; start before ready, ship at 80%, and solve one painful expensive problem for high-paying clients.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会；没准备好就开始，做到 80% 就发布，为高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题。

mengto.en: High intelligence can hold you back through overthinking and perfectionism; the safe corporate job is gone, so going on offense is the real low-risk move.
mengto.zh: 高智商可能因过度思考和完美主义而拖累你；安稳的公司工作已不存在，主动出击才是真正低风险的举动。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and allocation economy: AGI means profitable indefinite agents; CEOs must dogfood AI; generalists manage models.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让昂贵服务变得可负担、让更少美国工人服务更多人，成为推动就业回流美国的力量；AGI 的定义是无限运行智能体在经济上有利可图，而非通过图灵测试；CEO 是否每天亲自使用 AI 工具是公司成功采用 AI 的第一预测指标；分配经济下管理技能更有价值，通才胜出。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work replace CLIs; SaaS grows with agents; benchmarks overestimate autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化了智能体观点：每个人至少有一个智能体，但智能体需要关心它们的人类才能良好运作，自动化需要人类监督；CLI 已过时，Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等 GUI 是未来工作界面；SaaS 不会消亡，智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户；基准测试高估了 AI 自主性，现实任务仍需人类框架和监督。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste matter; automation creates more human work; humans are smarter than AI.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出：AI 是非特定放大器，放大你既有的心态和信念；用好 AI 需要带入自己的品味和手艺，工具不创造意义；自动化创造更多人类工作，冻结的能力被商品化，专家需要定制；人类比 AI 更聪明，AI 缺乏内在欲望，本质是遵循提示的工具，即使超级智能也仍需人类方向。

danshipper.en: AI adoption hinges on human oversight, craft, and curiosity; agents amplify rather than replace human value.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 的采用取决于人类监督、手艺和好奇心；智能体放大而非取代人类价值；AI 是工具，需要人类引导和反馈。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most products; coding agents are the most mature, and the model now eats the scaffolding.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年,智能体式 AI 对多数产品仍处爬行阶段,编码智能体最成熟;模型正在吃掉脚手架,如今的模型已包含智能体框架与工具,而非只有权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年他判断:编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来,其影响超过坐等 AGI（通用人工智能）;这延续了他对能力落地而非空谈终局的关注。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success means maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年他反共识地认为,智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的,而非自相残杀;成功指标应是最大化客户成果,而非产品上的眼球时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年他仍强调:长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主,他们想留在驾驶位;这与他对人类掌控的一贯重视相呼应。

logankilpatrick.en: Software creation will be mostly solved by 2026, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年他深化早期判断:软件创造到 2026 年基本被解决,反而带来千倍机会;工程、产品与研究的界限模糊,摆弄即研究,但深度理解代码仍关键。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence is sufficient, so product interface for human-agent collaboration is the real challenge.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；基础智能已经足够，真正的挑战在于设计人机协作的产品界面。

scottwu.en: Software engineering demand will increase via Jevons paradox, not decrease; AI will create more programmers, not fewer.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他坚持杰文斯悖论：AI 不会减少软件工程师，反而会增加需求与人数，编程将变得更重要。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual with continuous improvements, and enterprise adoption requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他反对 AGI 突变论，认为进展是渐进的；企业采用智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x in six months); productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens; independence enables model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编程智能体采用量六个月增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量；独立性带来模型中立与长期企业合作。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent—capacity, not efficiency, is the unlock.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他提出丰裕时代真实且临近；长期 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并非迫在眉睫，真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, and enterprise adoption will take years due to sales cycles.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的规模与互联网或移动互联网相当，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，而企业采用因销售周期需数年。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用转移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差，编程是前沿模型唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet or electricity; its impact is broad and indirect, and current usage remains shallow despite the hype.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像互联网或电力一样的使能技术；其影响广泛而间接，尽管炒作不断，当前使用仍然浅层。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Digital twins will compress clinical trials from years to days, and AI-designed personalized medicine will approach 100% efficacy.
derya.zh: 数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，AI 设计的个性化医疗将接近 100% 疗效。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives, aging is reversed, and cancer becomes 100% curable.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将到达长寿逃逸速度，衰老被逆转，癌症变得 100% 可治愈。

derya.en: Humanity, not AI, is the only existential threat; we should trust superintelligence for medical decisions and merge via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 人类自身而非 AI 才是唯一的存在性威胁；我们应信任超级智能做医疗决策，并通过脑机接口与之融合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining, and construction, arriving in 5-10 years; autonomy is urgently needed due to labor shortages and safety.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，5-10 年内到来；由于劳动力短缺和安全问题，自主化需求迫切。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing injuries and deaths; autonomous vehicles are already safer than human drivers and will save lives.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡；自动驾驶汽车已比人类司机更安全，将拯救生命。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across diverse vehicles and environments; diverse data from different verticals improves models faster.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Transformer 使通用的物理 AI 模型能跨多种车辆和环境；来自不同垂直领域的多样化数据能更快改进模型。

qasaryounis.en: The future of autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, which is more scalable than imitation learning; world models are evolving from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他表示自主化的未来在于端到端强化学习，它比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演变为神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI; automotive is only 30% of business, with growth in mining, agriculture, and defense.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他预测物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；汽车仅占业务的 30%，增长在采矿、农业和国防。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，必须从设计之初就内建，而非事后加装。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; reinforcement learning may increase hallucinations.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；强化学习反而可能加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits are here, so reasoning and search are needed for progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已遭遇收益递减；数据墙与算力上限已然到来，因此需要推理与搜索来推动进一步进展。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know; every output is a hallucination, some right, some wrong.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——它们无法知道自己不知道什么；每一次输出都是幻觉，有些对、有些错。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内建可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间、更开放式地运行；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking improves model quality, not just prevents harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考提升模型质量，而不只是防止危害。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolds.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向开放式、端到端智能体，轻量通用工具取代笨重脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Model taste is built by hands-on experimentation and creative prototyping; effort parameters deliver Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of the price.
diannepenn.zh: 2025→26 年，模型品味靠亲手实验与创造性原型打磨；effort 参数以极低成本实现 Opus 级智能。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core PM tools; coding differentiates, and safety alignment enables pushback, making Claude more useful.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具；编程成为差异化优势，安全对齐让 Claude 能反驳、更有用。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the top skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 产品经理必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日发布；当代码变得廉价，决定做什么的产品品味成为最重要的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, with Claude Tag landing 65% of product PRs.
catwu.zh: 编程智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断，Claude Tag 已承担 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as model judgment replaced hand-holding.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例和硬性约束；随着模型判断力取代手把手引导，系统提示词缩减了 80%。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong test suite rewriting is fine; humans can leave the outer-layer code review loop.
catwu.zh: 重写如今是好事：代码库就是一份规格说明，只要有强大的测试套件，重写就没问题；外层代码审查可以不再需要人类。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature; safe AGI is the unifying mission enabling fast cross-org decisions.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮，加上明确的留存与打磨内部标准，为每个功能把关；安全 AGI 是统一使命，支撑快速的跨组织决策。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并放在独立的安全环境中运行。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体开始，再拆分为多个专用智能体，以避免上下文窗口过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: The web is hostile to agents; APIs often beat browser use, and bugs signal product-market fit.
clairevo.zh: 网络对智能体并不友好；API 往往优于浏览器操作，而 bug 反而是产品市场契合的信号。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skills for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 要让智能体成功，角色界定与入职引导等管理技能比技术技能更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, with humans owning outcomes.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立严肃的业务，但人类仍需对结果负责。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆应内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are inseparable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索无法做到的联想回忆与更深层组合。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长程任务，因此靠更多算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from context rot; more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale, so weights must complement lossy compaction.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；即便到 1000 万规模，更多 token 反而降低准确率，因此权重必须补充有损的压缩。
