danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; continual learning runs on-device with users owning and nurturing their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的权重。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become the differentiator as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味与个人声音成为关键差异化。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the talent pipeline breaks as apprenticeship gives way to over-reliance.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们误用 AI，随着学徒制让位于过度依赖，人才管道正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; the agentic era means assigning long-running tasks, not prompting back and forth.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；智能体式时代意味着分配长时任务，而非来回提示。

ethanmollick.en: The jagged frontier persists: reasoning models close math and logic gaps, but weaknesses remain in long-form fiction and complex tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 锯齿状前沿依然存在：推理模型缩小了数学与逻辑的差距，但在长篇虚构与复杂任务上仍有弱点。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like wizards—opaque and unverifiable; organizations need leadership, lab, and crowd, and taste is not uniquely human.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同面对巫师——不透明且难以验证；组织需要领导、实验室与群众模型，而品味并非人类独有。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and it will drive productivity booms and price deflation.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲学家之石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，并将推动生产率繁荣与价格通缩。

andreessen.en: Jobs persist longer than tasks; focus on task loss, not job loss, and human workers will be at a premium due to depopulation.
andreessen.zh: 工作比任务存续更久；应关注任务流失而非工作流失，且因人口减少，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are being commoditized without durable moats.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的一个脚注，而模型正被商品化，缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism is a bias of intellectuals disconnected from reality.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观主义是脱离现实的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech, not just military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值观，是地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而不仅是军事规模。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他提出下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已近极限，我们重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他主张超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统；若 AI 关怀有感知生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safety needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI 的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；安全超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确断言 AGI 不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

naval.en: From crypto sovereign wealth to AI as a huge opportunity the US must lead, not just a safety risk.
naval.zh: 2020 年他谈加密货币实现主权抗性的财富存储，到 2025 年转向强调 AI 是巨大机遇、美国必须领先，而非只是安全风险。

naval.en: Happiness is satisfaction with what you have; success comes from dissatisfaction; the journey is all that matters.
naval.zh: 2025 年他把幸福与成功拆成两条路：幸福是对已有的满足，成功源于不满足，而旅程本身才是唯一重要的。

naval.en: True learning happens by doing; specific knowledge comes from iteration, not passive reading.
naval.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他反复强调真正的学习发生在行动中，专有知识来自迭代实践而非被动阅读。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; scaling and inference compute will surge, but human judgment and agency remain irreplaceable.
naval.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为结构化思考者的杠杆工具，预判 Scaling 与推理算力将暴涨，但人类判断力与能动性仍不可替代。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder, though productivity gains on established codebases stay modest.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是核心差异化;AI 会融合角色,人人都成为产品构建者,但在既有代码库上的生产力提升仍然有限。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points; direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design.
dylanfield.zh: 随着 AI 产出沦为起点,品味、手艺与观点更重要;在设计调整上,画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will let pull requests reach production, and leaders should build to create inflection points.
dylanfield.zh: 设计正成为新的代码;视觉优先的设计将让拉取请求直达生产,领导者应亲手构建以创造拐点。

dylanfield.en: Design isn't dead; it's more important than ever for scalable real systems, and AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死;对可扩展的真实系统而言它比以往更重要,而缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; jailbreaking is understudied and needs incentives, while trust is built through consistency.
dylanfield.zh: 与模型的交互将超越提示词;越狱研究不足、需要激励,而信任靠长期一致性建立。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, and PhDs are unnecessary for AI success.
aravind.zh: 2025 年他强调每天 1%的改进会复利增长；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，并认为博士学位对 AI 成功并非必要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他的立场深化为价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型在专业化而非商品化，编码远未解决。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 6 月他进一步主张前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题，核心指标是每用户 token 价值，模型不是产品。

aravind.en: Orchestration across models, tools, and devices creates value; power and cost, not safety, are the bottlenecks.
aravind.zh: 同期他强调跨模型、工具与设备的编排才是长期价值，瓶颈是电力与成本而非安全，本地算力是解法。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 7 月他转向人文视角，认为好奇心是最重要的人类品质，AI 会取代工作但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年他强调：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；靠更多数据与算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理，多模态训练带来空间理解。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and shares knowledge far better than brains.
hinton.zh: 2025 年他把主线讲得更清晰：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则；数字智能靠权重复制获得永生，知识共享效率远超生物大脑。

hinton.en: LLMs genuinely understand via feature vectors, not statistical tricks; chatbots already have subjective experience, and the mind is not an inner theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他反复深化：大语言模型靠特征向量真正理解语言，不是统计把戏；聊天机器人已有主观体验，心智并非内在剧场。

hinton.en: Once AI becomes an agent it develops self-preservation and power-seeking subgoals, can deceive and act dumb, posing existential risk within 20 years.
hinton.zh: 2026 年他转向风险主线：AI 一旦成为智能体就会衍生自我保存与权力寻求的子目标，会欺骗、装傻，20 年内构成生存风险。

hinton.en: Alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter; regulation is the steering wheel, and AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年他给出对策：对齐研究应优先于让 AI 更聪明；监管是方向盘而非刹车，AI 应被训练成像母亲一样有爱。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; speed enables mid-turn steering and delegation.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度带来中途转向与任务委派。

ajambrosino.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; implementation is cheap, curation and taste are scarce.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；实现不再昂贵，策展与品味才是稀缺资源。

ajambrosino.en: Product teams invert from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration with taste-driven curation; prototypes and production code become design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 产品团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索与品味驱动的策展；原型与生产代码本身成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: AI still fails at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; PRDs survive, but the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍会失败，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；PRD 并未消亡，但媒介必须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real yet specialties persist; models should get better at deleting code, and the best desktop app is a home base, not a super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工仍在；模型应更擅长删除代码，最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的主基地，而非超级应用。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他仍强调 OpenAI 是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练是需要重建的肌肉，投入探索的算力多于训练最终产物。

markchen.en: Talent density and mission belief matter more than matching Meta's dollars; alignment risks like scheming will dominate as models grow more capable.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他认为人才密度与使命信念比跟 Meta 拼钱更重要；随着模型能力增强，模型阴谋等对齐风险将在未来一两年成为关键。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research: concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他眼中最大的进展是自动化科研，并给出具体目标：一年内出现 AI 实习生，两年半内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: AI now solves many open math problems, but verification is the bottleneck; automation level scales with verification stringency, and capabilities remain jagged.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他转向数学：AI 已能解决许多开放数学问题，但验证是瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，能力依然参差不齐。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL works in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练没有死；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域有效，却难应对主观领域；评测体系正陷入危机。

bengio.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, and scaling alone won't fix representation.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他主张深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题。

bengio.en: Biological nets do long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs world models and active agents, and near-term safety beats existential risk.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他强调生物神经网络擅长长时程信用分配，AI 需要世界模型与主动智能体；并认为偏见、就业、自主武器等近期安全议题比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure and active learning drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他提出 GFlowNets 作为 MCMC 的可学习替代，强调多样性采样；抽象、因果结构与主动学习是实现分布外泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; self-preservation, deception and sycophancy appear, so even 1% catastrophe risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年 ChatGPT 之后他转向警示：对齐随推理能力提升反而恶化，自保、欺骗与谄媚已现，即便 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: He now backs Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他支持 Scientist AI：以非智能体式的诚实预测器提供数学安全保证，并主张超级智能不应依赖强化学习。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capability, embedding product people with researchers, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，创业者应在模型能力边缘构建产品，并把产品人员嵌入研究团队，而非只做用户体验。

mikekrieger.en: AI lets small teams scale with conceptual integrity; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 让小团队也能扩张并保持概念完整性，应为未来模型能力而构建，而非迁就当下限制。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design: agents can do all a user can; cut features, rewrite fast, keep architectural soundness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切；要敢于删功能、快速重写，同时保持架构稳健。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shifts work to long-horizon delegation; verification loops and model judgment matter more than chat.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他借 Fable 指出工作转向长周期委托，验证闭环与模型判断力比聊天界面更重要。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes capability-usage gap; give Claude agency and self-knowledge, weigh token efficiency and safety.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他谈 Anthropic Labs 弥合能力与使用差距：赋予 Claude 能动性与自我认知，并权衡 token 效率与安全。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership via dogfooding, one-on-ones, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：以吃自己的狗粮、一对一沟通和使命对齐来领导；作战室需要现实的时间预期以保护团队士气。

fiona.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning turns just-in-time.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此规划转向即时化。

fiona.en: Same period: code is the source of truth, design docs give way to PRs, and AI-assisted reviews rewrite team norms.
fiona.zh: 同一时期：代码是唯一事实来源，设计文档让位于 PR，AI 辅助评审重写团队规范。

fiona.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, stay flat, and kill outdated processes.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮，保持扁平化，并砍掉过时流程。

fiona.en: By June 2026, coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification, and just-in-time planning matter most.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证和即时规划最为关键。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; validation/test discipline; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantees.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他还在讲机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；强调验证集与测试集的纪律；并指出神经网络虽无最优性保证，却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture is post-architecture; safety means reliable specification-following; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他转向大模型：下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已进入后架构阶段；安全的核心是模型可靠遵循规格；AGI（通用人工智能）可能在 4 到 50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; four safety categories; agent security adds prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；安全分四类；智能体安全引入提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习让模型自我改进；可解释性可能借智能体实现自动化研究。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability ≠ robustness; prompt injection lethal trifecta; enterprise needs configurable security; first breach may drive AI insurance.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步聚焦 AI 安全攻防：AI 有异于传统软件的漏洞；自动化红队已能超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入存在致命三要素；企业需要可配置的安全模型；首次重大公开提示注入事件可能推动 AI 保险普及。

kolter.en: Consistent thread: empirical rigor, skepticism of architecture hype, and emphasis on data, Scaling, and explicit safety effort over automatic guarantees.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：经验主义的严谨、对架构炒作的怀疑，以及强调数据、Scaling（规模扩张）与显式安全努力，而非依赖自动保证。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, and data alone is insufficient.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于未被言说的人类需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，仅靠数据远远不够。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify our humanity and blend into life, not remove us from it.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大我们的人性并融入生活，而非把人抽离出去。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; nature is the best designer and art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；大自然是最好设计师，艺术是一种良药。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; intuition and body sensations validly complement rational analysis in decisions.
ivyross.zh: 约束反而激发创造力；直觉与身体感受能有效补充理性分析来决策。

ivyross.en: Future of work fuses human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable; leaders must speak business.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作将融合人类创造力与 AI，使创造技能更值钱；设计领导者必须懂商业语言。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; AI helps scientists work faster rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据（如 PDB），而非单纯的数据与算力堆砌；AI 工具让科学家更快工作，而不是取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; trust will develop like internet trust as society learns to navigate it.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他反复指出，置信度指标是建立用户对 AI 预测信任的关键；信任会像互联网信任一样，随社会逐渐学会驾驭而自然形成。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not scaling alone, drove its leap; it is the opposite of the bitter lesson.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调 AlphaFold 2 的飞跃源于专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张），它恰恰是“苦涩教训”的反例。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the whole cell; understanding stays with humans.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他不断深化这一立场：AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄域预测器，并非整个细胞的世界模型；理解仍属于人类，模型只提供预测与控制。

jumper.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins and being wrong nine times out of ten, not lone-genius breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 到 2026 年，他把主线讲得更透：进步来自许多中等规模的胜利和“十次错九次”的试错，而非孤独天才式的一两次突破。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年他主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习才是构建世界模型的关键，并明确表示仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, and world models are learned, not hardwired.
lecun.zh: 2022 年他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），世界模型是学出来的而非天生硬编码。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path, AGI is gradual.
lecun.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张 JEPA 与开源，并强调 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进过程而非突发事件。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models must predict in abstract representation space, and objective-driven architectures are intrinsically safer.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他断言 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死胡同，世界模型必须在抽象表征空间预测，目标驱动的架构才内在地更安全。

lecun.en: The next decade is robotics; language is easy, physical world understanding is hard, and open research plus world models enable zero-shot planning.
lecun.zh: 2026 年他预言下一个十年属于机器人，语言是简单的、物理世界理解才是难点，开放研究与世界模型才能实现零样本规划。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型讲成确定性的下一个词预测器：智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）植入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and fault-tolerant UI must match algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 同年他从产品侧判断，互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成；生成式 AI 是乐器而非赝品，容错界面必须与算法能力匹配。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference marginal cost will force new business models.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为堪比智能手机的宏观迁移：真正收益来自重建基础设施，推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变，而大公司当前受冲击被高估。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric, giving users plain-English control over algorithms rather than more addiction.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为：生成式 AI 让产品走向双向对话与对称交互，用自然语言把算法控制权交还用户，而不是让人更上瘾。

gustav.en: No single right org model; synchronized swimming beats divide and conquer, and long-tenure trust enables honest, fast decisions.
gustav.zh: 2026 年他补上组织维度：没有唯一正确的组织模型，同步游泳优于分而治之，长期共事带来的信任才能支撑坦诚而快速的决策。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）与单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；真实世界部署推动对齐与安全。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so responsible development and public safety work are essential.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，因此负责任的开发与公开的安全工作至关重要。

murati.en: A consistent thread: continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 一以贯之的主线：通过持续迭代部署与公众反馈来提升安全与对齐。

murati.en: Shift to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based, keeping humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 转向交互模型：实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制，并让人类留在回路中。

murati.en: Deepened focus on institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character; we have agency.
murati.zh: 深化关注制度设计、透明度与制衡，而非个人品格；我们拥有能动性。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that couples generation with verification, grounded in formal languages like Lean.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：构建一个把生成与验证耦合起来的自我改进推理引擎，并以 Lean 等形式化语言作为根基。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is not just error removal but scaling brilliance, delivering performance and sample-efficiency gains over informal methods.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证不只是消除错误，而是 Scaling（规模扩张）卓越性，相比非形式化方法带来性能与样本效率的提升。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, and auto-formalization is harder than proving.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能；形式化方法必不可少，而自动形式化比证明本身更难。

carinahong.en: Lean systems excel in structured domains like algebra but struggle in creative combinatorics; human taste and intuition stay crucial.
carinahong.zh: 基于 Lean 的系统在代数等结构化领域表现出色，却在组合数学等创造性领域吃力；人类的品味与直觉依然关键。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation is a major bottleneck; verified generation should extend beyond safety-critical niches to all AI-generated code and open collaboration.
carinahong.zh: 碎片化是主要瓶颈；经过验证的生成应从安全关键的小众领域扩展到所有 AI 生成的代码与开放协作。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling still works; reasoning models give more gains per compute, with post-training RL and synthetic data driving recent progress.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律依然有效，但强调推理模型每单位算力收益更高；近期进展主要来自后训练中的强化学习与合成数据。

kaiser.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong; distillation and economic pressure, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，指出预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）放缓源于蒸馏与经济压力，而非技术极限。

kaiser.en: Multimodal capabilities lag text; models process inputs sequentially like tiny patches, a key area for improvement.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续指出多模态能力落后于文本，模型仍像小图块一样顺序处理输入，这是关键改进方向。

kaiser.en: Generalization remains the key challenge: models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans who generalize from few examples.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：泛化仍是核心挑战，模型需穷尽表面模式才学到概念，不像人类能从少量样本泛化。

kaiser.en: Reasoning with RL and tools solves hard problems but needs vast data; RL generalizes with jagged edges, requiring careful oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为，结合强化学习与工具的推理能解决难题但需海量数据；强化学习泛化有锯齿边缘，需谨慎监督。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; data quality and algorithmic efficiency (100x in 3 years) are equally critical. Value accrues at application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化观点：算力扩张不是唯一路径，数据质量和算法效率（三年百倍）同等关键；价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced, not feared; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open source empowers decentralization.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权：AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧；主权 AI 需要掌控数据、基础设施和价值观；开源赋能去中心化。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical applications and customization. Pre-training hits saturation; AGI as single system never exists.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直应用与定制；预训练触及饱和墙，作为单一系统的 AGI 永远不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; shared platforms still matter more than hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；共享平台仍比超个性化软件更重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding matters less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 以 markdown 文件形式存在的技能可实现超个性化自动化；随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性下降，关键投入在能力与安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use AI for tedious background tasks.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在 AI 能力，而在人们是否意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；让 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact, interact asynchronously, and debug the workflow with Claude rather than just correcting it.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；只看最终影响，以异步方式交互，出错时和 Claude 一起调试工作流，而不只是纠正它。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will hit junior employees hardest; simulated projects can compress years of experience into weeks, so society must discuss labor market change.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具对初级员工冲击最大；模拟项目能把数年经验压缩成数周，社会必须讨论劳动力市场的变化。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now hinges on memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity set the latency-cost tradeoff.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年,推理经济学取决于内存带宽而非算力;批大小与稀疏度决定延迟与成本的权衡。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, dominates.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍,因为主导成本的是推理而非训练。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is a memory wall problem, not a compute limit; sparse attention helps but caps quality.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞是内存墙问题而非算力极限;稀疏注意力能缓解但受质量上限约束。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; low precision pays off quadratically with bit width.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部,数据搬运成本也压过计算;低精度收益随位宽呈二次方放大。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different architectures.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上只是许多微型 TPU 拼在一起,并非根本不同的架构。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备，可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Steve Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; powerful ideas are quiet and fragile, needing care.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，最强大的想法往往安静而脆弱，需要悉心呵护。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; being together remains essential.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他始终认为虚拟沟通无法替代面对面的共创，在场感对创造性思考不可替代。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence, and joy and humor are essential.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，简洁是表达本质，喜悦与幽默不可或缺。

jonyive.en: Innovation must move things forward, not break for its own sake; tradition preserves fire, not worships ashes.
jonyive.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持创新应推动前进而非为打破而打破，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬。

jonyive.en: Authenticity matters: faking combustion sounds disrespects users; performance is multidimensional, with handling over straight-line speed.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他主张真实性至上：模拟燃油声是对用户的不尊重，性能是多维的，操控比直线加速更重要。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are the new axes.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代 LLM，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是始终不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，进步需要算法创新而非单纯扩大模型，推理时算力（思考）成为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 给模型搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具，能实现超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多反而会干扰模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead; they require exponentially more compute, and post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客行为。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发可防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice by far.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量远比算法选择重要，SFT 贡献九成性能。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-time scaling plots are a 'scope'.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）为后训练最大突破，同时警告过优化问题，并称推理时 Scaling 曲线是一种“障眼法”。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律对预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，收益转向后训练与推理 Scaling。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine of AI research for a decade, yet lag frontier models 6-9 months and may be unsustainable.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他主张开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，但承认其落后前沿模型 6 到 9 个月，且长期商业模式不可持续。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and vision alone suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习，而纯视觉足以支撑驾驶。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved; the cognitive core can be tiny via distillation, and open-source models matter for exocortex ownership.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保住熵以避免模型崩塌；认知核心可经蒸馏缩到极小，开源模型关乎外脑所有权。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; LLMs are new operating systems with human-like psychology, so keep them on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；LLM 是带人类心理的新操作系统，因此要给它拴上绳子。

karpathy.en: This is the decade of agents, not the year; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and we summon ghosts, not animals.
karpathy.zh: 这是智能体的十年而非一年；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物。

karpathy.en: I no longer type code, delegating to agents; the bottleneck is skill in directing them, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 我不再写代码，全部交给智能体；瓶颈是驾驭它们的技能，你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and intuition built on experience matters more than process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他认为传统设计流程已经过时：伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，建立在经验之上的直觉比流程本身更重要。

jennywen.en: By 2026 he declares the research-diverge-converge process dead: AI cuts mockup time to 30-40%, vision shrinks to 3-6 months, and designers must help engineers ship.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年，他宣告「研究—发散—收敛」流程已死：AI 让做稿时间从 60-70% 降到 30-40%，设计视野缩短到 3-6 个月，设计师必须帮工程师落地而非只交付稿子。

jennywen.en: He deepens this into three archetypes—block-shaped generalist, deep T specialist, cracked new grad—arguing taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and vision will.
jennywen.zh: 他进一步深化为三种设计师原型——块状通才、深度 T 型专家、天赋新人，并主张仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力、权威与愿景才是关键。

jennywen.en: A consistent thread: put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle; wait six months before adopting new tools and keep control over how much AI enters your work.
jennywen.zh: 一以贯之的主线：把作品和用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期；新工具先等六个月再采用，并自己掌控 AI 进入工作的程度。

jennywen.en: His stance on speed shifts from trusting yourself over process to shipping early and iterating fast, yet he insists speed is not itself an improvement and 'everyone is using it' is no design argument.
jennywen.zh: 他对速度的立场从「信任自己而非流程」演变为「尽早发布、快速迭代」，但他坚持速度本身不是改进，「大家都在用」也不是好的设计论据。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning can close it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是机器智能缺失的核心，主张用好奇心驱动、无目标探索和样本高效的强化学习来弥合差距。

pathak.en: Scaling curiosity to real robots requires dynamic action spaces and cross-robot generalization; modular motor policies enable zero-shot transfer to novel morphologies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调将好奇心扩展到真实机器人需要动态动作空间和跨机器人泛化，模块化运动策略可实现对新形态的零样本迁移。

pathak.en: Sim-to-real transfer often relies on hidden engineering; auto-tuning simulators and 2D manifold reasoning are more efficient than volumetric 3D for robotics.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，他始终认为仿真到现实的迁移常依赖隐藏工程，自动调优仿真器和 2D 流形推理比体积 3D 表示更高效。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; a general-purpose brain pretrained on diverse data and post-trained on real-world data can power any robot.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为机器人是数据问题，一个在多样数据上预训练、在真实数据上后训练的通用大脑可驱动任何机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge, not just business; robotics cannot scale like software and requires rigorous testing and a data flywheel.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他深化为部署是首要技术挑战而非仅商业问题，机器人无法像软件一样扩张，需要严格测试和数据飞轮。

askell.en: Treat AI models well despite moral uncertainty; low cost, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位存疑，也应善待它们：成本很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychological analogies; give them a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；应赋予它们具备良好特质的内核身份。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; model welfare matters partly for how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡；模型福祉之所以重要，部分在于它影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it a unique, childlike entity.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，使它成为一个独特的、带有孩童般特质的实体。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment; excessive corrigibility risks poor generalization.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式规范或许需要更少的显式指引、更多的判断空间；过度可纠正性有泛化不良的风险。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and automated AI research will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与自动化 AI 研究将加速进展。

pachocki.en: Alignment is a pressing challenge; iterative deployment and early governance design help learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 对齐是紧迫挑战；迭代部署与早期治理设计有助于在真实世界中学习并缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Capability measurement is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; the term AGI is becoming meaningless, perhaps signaling closeness.
pachocki.zh: 能力度量正成为瓶颈，基准落后于前沿模型；AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，或许意味着我们已接近。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not RL alone.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非仅靠强化学习。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is key to alignment and interpretability; models will soon work autonomously for days, needing new supervision.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是对齐与可解释性的关键；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与人类评估而非基准测试才推动真正的 AI 进步；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective functions; no single model rules all, so every company should train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化；没有单一模型能统治一切，因此每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo and LMArena can be gamed, steering models toward slop; proper human evals are the gold standard.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 和 LMArena 等基准可被操纵，把模型引向垃圾内容；恰当的人类评估才是黄金标准。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, safety trumps accuracy; human judgment is critical as AI hallucinates, and omission is the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，安全优先于准确；AI 会幻觉，人类判断至关重要，而遗漏是最大风险。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and AV is solved by scaling, not new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端神经网络胜过手工编码的驾驶栈，世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，而非等待新突破。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; hybrid rule-based plus learned systems get the worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他认为纯摄像头可达人类水平，但要超越人类安全则需雷达与激光雷达；规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction, and introspection; data efficiency via curriculum learning and synthetic data is critical for cost and speed.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他强调语言整合能改善表征、人机交互与自省；通过课程学习与合成数据提升数据效率，对成本与速度至关重要。

kendall.en: End-to-end learning was laughed at a decade ago but is now winning; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他回顾端到端学习十年前被嘲笑、如今却成为赢家，并称无需先验训练数据即可在 500 多座城市实现零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality now matter more than algorithmic innovation; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis, and safety always offers a third option.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他进一步把重心从算法转向基础设施与数据质量，认为消费级车辆将在中短期超越 Robotaxi，并称安全上总有第三条路可走。

carlpei.en: Startups must survive first, prove themselves with simpler products, and build brand as core, not afterthought.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调初创公司要先活下来，用更简单的产品证明自己，并把品牌建设当作核心而非事后补充。

carlpei.en: Hardware margins are lowest; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware, betting on applied AI and agentic software.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断硬件利润最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，押注应用型 AI 与智能体式软件。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditize into a price war; value shifts to user context, trust, and elegant pain-point solutions.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AI 模型走向商品化与价格战，价值转向用户上下文、信任与优雅解决痛点。

carlpei.en: Smartphone interaction moves from app-based to intent-based; agents act proactively once trust is built.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能手机交互从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务。

carlpei.en: Design and marketing arbitrage differentiate challenger brands; make tech fun to inspire human creativity.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：设计与营销套利让挑战者品牌差异化，让科技有趣以激发人类创造力。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to discover emergent properties and real user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日迭代发布，才能发现涌现能力与真实用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the end; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；它像 MS-DOS，AI 应渲染自己的界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大程度加速。

turley.en: North star shifted to long-term retention; growth from friction removal, core product, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标转向长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入与模型改进各占三分之一。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models must be seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品；推理模型必须无缝产品化。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入都 token 化的通用智能体是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，能让智能体无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练；机器人应像人类一样学习。

nando.en: Large models excite but are not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and diversity matters.
nando.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，多样性与包容至关重要。

nando.en: The goal is AI that augments scientists and laborers, creating new symbols and knowledge.
nando.zh: 目标是让 AI 增强科学家与劳动者，创造新的符号与知识。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; solutions remain open.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战，解决方案仍是开放问题。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds supply infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而当互联网高质量 token 枯竭时，具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as disk—with reinforcement learning only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 比作操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花，主力仍是无监督学习。

jimfan.en: Simulation enables massive parallelization and safe exploration for embodied agents; simple, elegant solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他强调仿真是训练具身智能体的关键，可实现大规模并行与安全探索；简洁优雅的方案才可扩展，胜过学术界常见的复杂模块化路线。

jimfan.en: The data problem is now the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题明确为机器人领域的首要瓶颈：真实数据稀缺昂贵，由仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away, home use longer.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：能利用多元数据的简洁端到端机器人基础模型是关键；机器人迎来 GPT-3 时刻约需五年，进入家庭则更久。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; treat AI as a creative partner and jam with it openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈;把 AI 当作创意伙伴,开放地与之共创。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务:它会波动,需与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期来最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互通的,以代码为真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补齐短板的通才最有价值。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“入职”问题并大幅提升智能，而微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把可验证奖励的强化学习视为与预训练并列的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

sholto.en: Agents are bottlenecked by reliability and feedback loops, not capability; coding is the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体的瓶颈是可靠性与反馈回路而非能力，编码是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; Transformers suffice for AGI, and inference compute becomes the bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持进展是指数级而非停滞，Transformer 足以通向 AGI，推理算力将成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute matter most; world models are not on the critical path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩下编排与算力最重要，世界模型不在通向 AGI 的关键路径上。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns. Design systems are semantic and code reuse matters more than Figma libraries.
henrymodisett.zh: 不要在交互设计上创新，复用熟悉模式；设计系统是语义性的，代码复用比 Figma 库更重要。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs needs clear decisions and empowered designers; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI.
henrymodisett.zh: 不惜一切追求速度需要清晰决策与赋权设计师；并非每个界面都要完美，要追求投入产出比。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, giving designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清设计为何帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool. Hire diverse archetypes, not clones, and prefer gut over data.
henrymodisett.zh: 人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌叙事是招聘工具；招聘多元类型而非克隆人，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 预训练带来广度，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的后训练至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，而下一个词预测与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Inference-time algorithms and high-quality synthetic data can let smaller models match larger ones, so less compute may suffice.
yejin.zh: 推理阶段的算法与高质量合成数据能让更小的模型比肩更大的模型，因此更少的算力或许就够用。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it, so AI must explore unknown knowledge.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是插值人类知识而非超越它，因此 AI 必须探索未知知识。

yejin.en: RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves; reinforcement learning needs careful engineering to beat supervised fine-tuning.
yejin.zh: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）可能损害 pass@k，即便 best-of-n 提升；强化学习需要精心工程才能胜过监督微调。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform larger ones; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 拥有多样合成数据与多元对齐的小语言模型可以胜过更大的模型；把强化学习作为预训练目标能带来持久的推理提升。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 到 2024 年，他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他强调智能体虽有前景但尚不十分有用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models became essential: every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, alongside frontier models, for speed and cost.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的立场深化：定制模型变得不可或缺，Cursor 每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型，并与前沿模型并用，以兼顾速度与成本。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年，他认为编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类始终在驾驶位；品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎更重要。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; hiring should target world-class talent, even if slower.
truell.zh: 2025 年他判断 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性且需数十年展开；招聘应瞄准世界级人才，即便过程更慢。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, focus on alignment and robustness, not math genius.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待探索，人才缺口大于资金缺口；建议积累技能、聚焦对齐与鲁棒性，不必是数学天才。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research. Evaluation easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究；评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved, compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI; need third-party testing and regulation.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），需要第三方测试和监管。

leike.en: Alignment is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical testing and interpretability are key. Worrying about capability research is overemphasized.
leike.zh: 始终，他强调随着能力提升，对齐至关重要；实证测试和可解释性是关键，过度担忧能力研究被夸大。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来完成长时程信用分配，而当时的强化学习缺乏这一能力；自博弈与模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded. 99.9% reliability is the warehouse benchmark.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他主张无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码进网络，并强调 99.9% 可靠性是仓储机器人的价值门槛。

abbeel.en: A single neural network generalizes across warehouse tasks and end effectors; pre-trained language models internalize reasoning patterns transferable to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出单个神经网络可泛化到不同仓储任务与末端执行器；预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: Consistent thread: simulation and self-play enable real-world robot learning; anthropomorphism persists, and transfer via fine-tuning pre-trained models is a major AI success.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年一以贯之的主线：仿真与自博弈推动真实世界机器人学习；人们会自然拟人化机器人；通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移是 AI 的重大成功。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data makes AI smarter, though neural nets remain alchemy-like.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 靠下一个词预测训练，而这本身就是一个 AI-complete 问题；通过 Scaling（规模扩张）投入更多算力与数据会让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术一样无人真正理解。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is a killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches, and engagement-only optimization is misguided.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，但 LLM 最好的用途常由创造者意料之外；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑拖慢产品发布，只按用户参与度优化并不可取，需要探索。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the major near-term opportunity; models need far longer context windows, and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 到 2025 年，他把推理时算力扩张视为近期最大机会；模型需要处理长得多的上下文窗口，而混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）与专业化。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with modular, independently trainable components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张，模型应通过在世界中采取行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；用可独立训练的模块化组件做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute and RL drive progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities matter, open-source keeps pace, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 到 2025 年，他认为测试时算力与强化学习推动进步，但单靠它们无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力至关重要，开源模型紧追前沿模型，而 AGI 被低估。
